metadata.description: A collection of useful development plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: review-plugin
plugins.description: Adds a /review command for quick code reviews

plugins.name: explain-plugin
plugins.description: Adds an /explain command to explain code in detail

plugins.name: test-plugin
plugins.description: Adds a /gentest command to generate unit tests

plugins.name: prompt-optimizer-plugin
plugins.description: Optimize any prompt before execution. Available as /optimize command, prompt-optimizer-skill, and prompt-optimizer-sub-agent.

plugins.name: sys-prompt-generator
plugins.description: Generate production-ready AI system prompts. Available as /generate-system-prompt (one-shot), /system-prompt-generator (interactive), and sys-prompt-agent (autonomous sub-agent).
